crossRefs.note: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

translations.web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
translations.bsb: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
translations.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion
translations.asv: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
